walls.note: Marcus's marked pond-side rock, 2026-09-27: exposed granite inside the traced 2025 ortho outline; west-facing bank towards the fairway and pond, 2.2-5.7 m high in the edited lidar DEM.
Hole 13 front tee: the whole downhill side, from the path (W) round the north to the NE; 1-2.5 m. Photo c219a56f shows three courses on the NE.
Hole 13 middle tee: the north side, 0.7-2.4 m, turning at the west end (photo 7176f1a2: two courses).
Hole 4: klippa A, the rock knoll's face towards the fairway (3.5-4.4 m in the lidar, 57 deg; Marcus: ~70 deg, 60-80 natural). Bare mossy granite on the 2023 leaf-off photo.

boulders.note: Bare grey boulder at the east end of the middle tee's wall (photo e77aaa87, left, bearing 201 deg; ortho: grey rock ~3 x 4 m with its shadow to the NE). Not in the edited DEM.
At the path's west edge: about 5 x 7 m, long side NW-SE; lidar top 89.9 m, highest ground under it 88.5 m.
Its neighbour 1 m to the west: about 4 x 5 m; lidar top 88.4 m, highest ground under it 87.7 m (2 m lower downhill).
Single pale stone in the open grass 60 m to the SE, about 3 x 3.5 m in the 2023 ortho; low: the lidar's top points are 0.15 m over the highest ground under it, on a slope.
The biggest, westmost: about 4 x 4.5 m, lidar top 84.5 m over ground at 82.8 m.
Small stone against A's east side.
East of A: lidar top 83.5 m over ground at 82.6 m.
About 3.3 x 2.8 m: lidar top 82.9 m, highest ground under it 82.2 m (1 m lower downhill).
Eastmost, nearest the forward tee: about 3.7 x 4.4 m, lidar top 83.3 m, highest ground under it 82.5 m.
Small stone 5 m NW of A.
Small stone between C and D.
